placeholders.{name}: The user's first name (from onboarding). In prompts.json it means the person being prayed for instead.
placeholders.{hours}: Hours a day from the scroll quiz, with its unit, e.g. "3 hours", "1 hour", "2.5 hours".
placeholders.{days}: Full days a year from the mirror math: hours × 365 ÷ 24, rounded to a whole number.
placeholders.{streak}: Current streak in days, as a number.
placeholders.{verseRef}: Today's verse reference from verses.json, e.g. "Psalm 46:10".

welcome.headline: Knees before feeds.
welcome.subline: Pray to Scroll puts a short prayer between you and the apps that eat your day. Pray, press and hold Amen, and you’re in.

scrollQuiz.headline: How many hours a day do you scroll?
scrollQuiz.subline: No judgment. If you’re not sure, check Screen Time. Most of us guess low.

mirror.headline: That’s {days} days a year.
mirror.subline: {hours} a day adds up to {days} full days every year. What if a few minutes of that went to God first?

promise.headline: Here’s the deal.
promise.subline: When you open a gated app, Pray to Scroll asks for a moment with God first. It can be 30 seconds. Then you press and hold Amen, and the app is yours.

chooseApps.headline: Which apps pull you in?
chooseApps.subline: Pick the ones you open without thinking. Pray to Scroll will ask you to pray before they open.

unlockStyle.headline: How do you want to pray?
unlockStyle.subline: Choose your default. You can switch styles any time, even mid-week.

guided.title: Guided
guided.detail: 1 to 3 minutes: praise, confess, give thanks, ask.

verse.title: Verse + prayer
verse.detail: Read today’s verse, then pray it back to God.

forSomeone.title: Pray for someone
forSomeone.detail: Pick a person, pray for them, and let them know.

window.headline: How long should Amen unlock?
window.subline: After you pray, your apps stay open this long. Shorter windows mean more moments with God. 15 minutes is a good place to start.

reminders.headline: A gentle nudge, once a day.
reminders.subline: Pick a prayer time and Pray to Scroll will remind you then. You’ll also get a heads-up if your streak is at risk, and a verse in the morning. Never spam.

name.headline: What should we call you?
name.subline: Just your first name, so Pray to Scroll can greet you like a friend.

gateSetup.headline: Set up your Prayer Gate.
gateSetup.subline: A quick Shortcuts automation lets Pray to Scroll know when you open a gated app. It takes about a minute per app, and we’ll walk you through every tap.

firstPrayer.headline: Let’s pray. Right now.
firstPrayer.subline: Your first prayer takes about 30 seconds. When you’re done, press and hold Amen to unlock.

dailyReminder.title: Time to pray
dailyReminder.body: A quiet minute with God is waiting, {name}. Your feed can wait too.

dailyReminder.title: Pray first
dailyReminder.body: Before the next scroll, one short prayer. Hold Amen when you’re done.

dailyReminder.title: Your prayer time
dailyReminder.body: God isn’t in a hurry. For one minute, neither are you.

dailyReminder.title: Hey {name}
dailyReminder.body: Take 30 seconds with God. You’ll be glad you did.

dailyReminder.title: Knees before feeds
dailyReminder.body: Unlock your day the best way: a short prayer, right now.

streakAtRisk.title: Keep your {streak}-day streak
streakAtRisk.body: You haven’t prayed today yet. Thirty seconds is all it takes.

streakAtRisk.title: Still time today
streakAtRisk.body: Your {streak}-day streak is one quick prayer away from growing.

streakAtRisk.title: A quiet moment before bed?
streakAtRisk.body: One short prayer keeps your {streak}-day streak going. God’s listening.

streakAtRisk.title: {streak} days and counting
streakAtRisk.body: Pray tonight and keep it going. Even a whisper counts.

celebrations: Prayed instead of scrolled. That’s the whole thing.
Amen. You started in the right place.
That minute mattered. Go enjoy the next ones.
God heard every word, even the ones you didn’t say.
Prayer first, feed second. You’re getting good at this.
Another day, another Amen. Your streak grows.
You chose God before the scroll. Quietly huge.
One more moment the algorithm didn’t get.
Small prayer, real change. Keep going.
You showed up, and so did God.

people.title: Who’s on your heart?
people.message: Add the people you want to pray for. Pray to Scroll will remind you who hasn’t been prayed for in a while.

journal.title: Your prayer journal starts here
journal.message: After you pray, jot down a line about what’s on your heart. One day you’ll look back and see how far God has brought you.

circles.title: Pray better together
circles.message: Start a Prayer Circle with friends, share the code, and cheer each other on through the week.

answeredPrayers.title: Answers will show up here
answeredPrayers.message: When a prayer is answered, mark it Answered. This wall becomes a record of God’s faithfulness you can come back to.
